mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 5% for two consecutive months signals weakening consumer demand and profit pressure, which reduces earnings expectations and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE crosses above 5.0 and remains above for at least two months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when UNRATE > 5% for two months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) for two consecutive quarters signals deteriorating demand, which reduces corporate earnings and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 declines for two consecutive quarters
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of two consecutive quarterly declines in GDPC1 (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the federal funds rate above 4.5% for three consecutive months signals a restrictive monetary policy stance that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS crosses above 4.5% and remains above for at least three months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.5% for three months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in payroll employment (PAYEMS) above the prior peak for three consecutive months signals robust labor market expansion, which boosts earnings expectations and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS crosses above prior peak and remains above for at least three months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods when PAYEMS is above prior peak for three months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the industrial production index (INDPRO) above its prior peak for three consecutive months signals improving manufacturing output and economic growth, which increases earnings expectations and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO crosses above prior peak and remains above for at least three months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods when INDPRO is above prior peak for three months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) above its prior peak for two consecutive quarters signals strengthening demand, which boosts earnings expectations and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 crosses above prior peak and remains above for at least two quarters
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods when GDPC1 is above prior peak for two quarters (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 5% for two consecutive months combined with a decline in payroll employment (PAYEMS) below its prior trough for two consecutive months signals a severe labor market deterioration, which reduces earnings expectations and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE crosses above 5.0 and remains above for at least two months AND PAYEMS crosses below prior trough and remains below for at least two months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when UNRATE > 5% and PAYEMS below prior trough for two months (t-test p > 0.05).
